novel_features.name: Similar advertisers
novel_features.description: Find advertisers with overlapping category, assets, and serviceType to a given advertiser.
novel_features.rationale: Live demand fetch plus in-memory set intersection. Trivial in one CLI call; expensive to brute-force over the API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pre-bid competitive analysis: 'who else is competing for this category?'

novel_features.name: Click chain verifier
novel_features.description: Walk the /c/{impressionId} redirect chain, validate the URL scheme, and confirm the final landing matches the advertiser's clickUrl.
novel_features.rationale: Multi-step HTTP verification with scheme allowlist validation. The API does not expose this introspection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: End-to-end attribution debugging in one command instead of three curl invocations.

novel_features.name: Spec drift detector
novel_features.description: Re-fetch the published OpenAPI spec, compare schemas against what the live API actually returns, flag drift.
novel_features.rationale: Requires correlating spec schemas with live response bodies. The spec is published statically; drift is invisible until something breaks.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catches contract drift the same way the press scorecard would - before downstream integrators do.

novel_features.name: Local demand mirror
novel_features.description: Fetch /demand and upsert into a local SQLite store so freshness, replay, watch, and trust-history queries work offline.
novel_features.rationale: The API exposes the current projection only; freshness, history, and replay all require a local mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Prerequisite for every offline-readable transcendence command; turns a stateless API into one with a history.

novel_features.name: Stale demand finder
novel_features.description: List demand entries the local mirror hasn't seen refreshed within the last N hours.
novel_features.rationale: The API does not expose first/last-seen timestamps. Without a local log there is no way to detect churned advertisers.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Spot churned advertisers before placing campaigns against names that are about to disappear from the pool.

novel_features.name: Demand index health report
novel_features.description: Composite freshness + coverage + trust report across the locally synced demand index.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates last_seen_at, scoutscore_history, and a known-categories diff into one report. Multi-query, no API equivalent.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Single-call health dashboard for the index; tells you immediately whether a category has zero coverage.

novel_features.name: Placement replay diff
novel_features.description: Re-issue a previously logged placement request to the live API and diff the new winner, scoutScore, decision, and ranking size against the original.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a stored request context plus a live POST; impossible without the local log.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catches ranking and scoutScore drift between two timepoints — useful when an advertiser keeps losing to the same competitor.

novel_features.name: Placement log tailer
novel_features.description: Poll the local placement log and stream new auction outcomes as a compact line or JSONL stream.
novel_features.rationale: API has no streaming endpoint; the local log is the only durable record per publisher.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Live tail for in-flight auction outcomes so a publisher can see decisions land in real time.

novel_features.name: Auction ranking explainer
novel_features.description: Decode the auction.ranking[] from a logged placement into a sorted human table (rank, service, score, bid, eligible, reason).
novel_features.rationale: The API returns ranking as a nested object; reading it requires a parser. This command does the work.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns an opaque JSON blob into a readable explanation of *why* a given advertiser won (or didn't).

novel_features.name: Trust-score time series
novel_features.description: Render a sparkline + table of locally observed trust scores for a campaign or advertiser id.
novel_features.rationale: The API returns the current score only. The local mirror logs each observation per sync run.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Visual trust audit trail — watch a campaign's score drift up or down over weeks.

novel_features.name: Campaign-by-wallet grouper
novel_features.description: Group locally mirrored campaigns by x402 payer wallet with per-wallet count, total balance, and category list.
novel_features.rationale: API surfaces campaigns one at a time. Wallet-level rollups need a local mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Spot one advertiser running multiple campaigns from the same wallet (common with agencies).

narrative.headline: Every Operon API endpoint plus 10 compound queries the API does not expose: similar-advertiser lookup, click-chain verification, spec drift detection, a local SQLite mirror with sync, demand freshness and health, placement replay and watch, auction explain, trust-score history, and campaign group-by-wallet.
narrative.value_prop: operon-pp-cli is the agent-native CLI and MCP server for Operon, the ad network for AI agents. It wraps the full placement and demand surface with agent-native UX (typed exit codes, --json/--select/--compact, --dry-run on every mutation), adds three live-composition queries on top of the API (demand similar, click follow, spec verify), and ships a local SQLite store + sync command that unlocks seven more transcendence queries (demand stale, demand health, placement replay, placement watch, auction explain, campaign trust-history, campaign group-by-wallet).
narrative.auth_narrative: Two auth lanes. For read-only inspection and the sandbox /placement lane, set X-Operon-Client to any well-formed UUID via the auto-generated config file. For production placements, set OPERON_AD_NETWORK_BEARER_AUTH to a Bearer key issued by Operon ops. The doctor command reports which lane is active.

quickstart.comment: Verify auth setup, network reachability, and spec contract.
Sync /demand into the local SQLite store. Prerequisite for every transcendence command below.
Composite freshness + coverage report over the locally synced demand index.
Find advertisers overlapping with adv_changenow on category, serviceType, or assets.
Decode the stored ranking[] for an impression into a sorted table.

troubleshoots.fix: Set X-Operon-Client header to a well-formed UUID v4. Run `operon-pp-cli doctor` to confirm the header is sent. The config file generated at first run includes a default UUID.
60/min per Bearer key, 100/hour per UUID in the sandbox lane. Wait the Retry-After interval; use --dry-run to iterate without consuming quota.
Registration is feature-flagged on the server. Email support@<vendor> if you hit this in production.
Spec mismatches are real findings. If drift appears, file an issue with the probe output.

troubleshoots.symptom: demand stale / demand health reports `No demand entries synced`
troubleshoots.fix: Run `operon-pp-cli sync` to populate the local SQLite store before invoking local-read commands.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for operon-pp-cli when you need to debug an Operon integration outside of @operon/sdk's Node-only surface, when you need cross-advertiser composition queries the API does not expose (similar-advertiser lookup, click chain walking, spec drift detection, freshness, replay, auction explain, trust history, wallet rollups), or when you want to expose Operon as MCP tools to a non-Node agent runtime via the bundled operon-pp-mcp binary.

recipes.title: Sanity-check a placement request before integrating @operon/sdk
recipes.command: operon-pp-cli placement --impression-context-request-context-query "swap USDC for SOL" --impression-context-request-context-category DeFi --impression-context-request-context-intent swap --impression-context-request-context-asset USDC --dry-run --json
recipes.explanation: Submit a synthetic impression context via --dry-run. Returns the request payload without sending so you can verify the contract shape before integrating from @operon/sdk.

recipes.title: Find DeFi advertisers competing for swap intent
recipes.explanation: Live set-intersection over the demand index. Useful before submitting a new advertiser to see who else is in the same lane.

recipes.title: Verify the published spec matches live API behavior
recipes.explanation: Re-fetches operon.so/openapi.json, probes documented GET endpoints with a short timeout, and reports any drift between documented and actual response shapes.

recipes.title: Walk a click attribution chain end-to-end
recipes.explanation: Reads the /c/{impressionId} redirect Location header, validates the URL scheme (https/http only), detects the operon.so fallback, and HEADs the landing URL to confirm it responds.

recipes.title: Refresh the local mirror and inspect index health
recipes.explanation: One sync run, then a single-call health report covering totals, fresh vs stale entries, per-category counts, average trust score per category, and any known categories that lack coverage.

recipes.title: Replay a placement to detect ranking drift
recipes.explanation: Re-POST the original /placement request and diff the new winner, scoutScore, decision, and ranking size against what was logged the first time.
